title: ID0434681-DC/Si-D/IL- [MP / P4 170000446] 24VDC Fuse Error
description:
Dear Siemens Team,
We would like to report a malfunction with charging station model MP / P4,
serial number 170000446.
The latest error received from the station is:
001: Other type of error. More information in Vendor Error Code -
24VDC_Fuse_FC12_to_FC17
This message was logged on 01/07/2025 at 14:19:08.389.
Following the error, we performed a reboot of the station, but it did not
reconnect to the network.
We kindly request your guidance on how to proceed and clarification if this
error indicates a component failure, blown fuse, or the need to replace any
parts.
Your prompt assistance would be greatly appreciated.
Best regards,
Ziv Vinitzer
Head of DC Charging

As per request from the Customer of Faulty charger.
We have checked the Logs of the Charger.
We could see that the Charger having 24VDC fuse error flag.
It is due to the Mainfan GQ1 issue. As shown below.
We need to

additional_info.subject: Re:‏ ID0434681-DC/Si-D/IL- [MP / P4 170000446] 24VDC Fuse Error CRM:02919000060
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Team,
Following a thorough investigation regarding the malfunction in charging station , serial number 170000446, we have determined that the root cause was a missing phase (L3) due to an external power grid issue from the utility company.
This was not related to the charging station itself but caused by a fault in the external electrical network.
Therefore, no further action is required from your side, and you may close the support case.
Thank you for your cooperation.
Best regards,
Ziv Vinitzer
Head of DC Charging
